data.content_ref: inline:The target reduces the 3-of-26 result to a generic confound (one repository, one author, one week) without engaging the specific distribution that makes the record evidential. It treats the 1/9 compile.py loss and the 4/4 to 6/7 banding as 'within the typical dispersion of such a draw,' but provides no statistical model, no confidence interval, and no threshold for what dispersion would falsify this assertion—rendering the claim empirically inert. The problem asks under what conditions a test constrains rather than describes; the target answers only that we cannot know (the magnitude is not established), leaving the question of constraint conditions entirely unaddressed.
